title: Resemble AI Ad Study Finds 1 In 11 Ads On Meta Platforms Contain AI-Generated Media, Many Featuring UGC-Style“Reviews”
ai_summary: Resemble AI's 2026 Synthetic Advertising Report scanned 37,768 ads from 509 brands, finding 8.9% contained AI-generated media, with 70% photoreal and only 0.06% disclosing AI use. The study highlights UGC-style reviews and audio-only fakes, urging brands to watermark and label AI content.

title: Nepal floods: Is the footage you’re seeing real or AI?
ai_summary: The Independent reported that viral footage of Nepal's ongoing floods is spreading across social media, and used deepfake detection tools including Resemble AI to distinguish real from AI-generated clips. Alan Turing Institute's Sam Stockwell said the main incentive for such content is capturing attention and advertising revenue, creating a financial opportunity.

title: Resemble AI Launches DETECT-World, the First Deepfake Detector Built on World Model Architecture
ai_summary: Resemble AI launched DETECT-World, a deepfake detector built on world-model architecture that checks physical reality. The model achieves 99.5% audio accuracy and covers 54 languages, and is available via real-time streaming and batch APIs. It is designed to detect synthetic identity fraud, claims review, and other use cases.

title: Best voice cloning APIs for developers (2026)
ai_summary: A 2025 guide compares voice cloning APIs for developers, ranking them by use case. ElevenLabs leads on quality and language breadth, Cartesia on real-time latency, and Resemble AI on enterprise security. VEED's lip sync API is recommended for video output.
